name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Digital Marketing Analyst
summary: Digital marketing analyst with 15+ years turning campaign, website, and CRM data into decisions across SEO, paid media, email, and website performance, including 5+ years building the CRM/marketing-automation systems that generate that data. Built performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity for concurrent client accounts; at Wix, supported an e-commerce segment that grew website traffic 30% and conversion rates 25%. Partner with channel specialists across SEO, paid, and email to identify meaningful trends, question results that don't add up, and turn findings into recommendations non-technical stakeholders can act on.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity across concurrent client accounts, delivering insights to business owners on a regular cadence.
Track acquisition and retention using GA4 and CRM analytics, connecting campaign activity to business outcomes and flagging gaps in attribution.
Analyze complex marketing and operational datasets, extracting actionable insights and structured recommendations that improve campaign performance.
Conduct technical SEO audits, keyword-gap analyses, and competitor research, implementing fixes directly inside client CMS platforms.
Optimized a client's Google Ads account, cutting spam and low-quality leads and improving click-through quality, then diagnosed on-site CRO as the remaining conversion bottleneck.
Maintain consistent reporting definitions and data hygiene across GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping performance metrics comparable across concurrent client accounts.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs across inbound, paid media, and content channels, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Ran Google keyword research and search-term analysis to shape campaign targeting and content direction.
Translated performance data into strategic recommendations for multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels.
Managed integrated digital marketing strategies as strategic lead, coordinating execution and analysis across internal specialist departments.

bullets: Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics across 15-20 reseller accounts to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, translating usage data into specific product recommendations.
Onboarded and managed a reseller partner portfolio (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (roughly 94% retention) during tenure.
Shared structured, high-priority customer feedback with Product and Engineering to inform roadmap decisions.

Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
